This page lists 92 Craft keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `craft.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Craft to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t craft.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/craft.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Craft.app`; if Craft lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## General

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⎋` | Cancel |
| `⌘,` | Open Settings |
| `⌥⌘,` | See All Keyboard Shortcuts |

## Navigation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘←` | Navigate Back |
| `⌘[` | Navigate Back (alt) |
| `⌘→` | Navigate Forward |
| `⌥⌘→` | Navigate Into |
| `⌥⌘]` | Navigate Into (alt) |
| `⌘O` | Quick Open |
| `⌥⌘N` | Go to Daily Note |
| `⌥⌘⏎` | Open Link |

## View

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘.` | Toggle Focus Mode |
| `⌘\` | Toggle Left Sidebar |
| `⌘+` | Zoom In |
| `⌘-` | Zoom Out |
| `⌘0` | Actual Size |

## Documents

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘N` | New Document |
| `⌥⌘N` | New Quick Note |
| `⌫` | Delete Document |
| `⌘F` | Search in Space |
| `⌥⌘L` | Copy Deeplink to Current View |
| `⌥⇧⌘L` | Copy Deeplink to Selection |

## Tasks

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⌘T` | Mark Task as Done |
| `⌥⇧⌘T` | Mark Task as Cancelled |
| `Space` | Create New Task (in Tasks view) |

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |

| `⌘E` | Use Selection to Search |
| `⌘P` | Print |
| `Space` | Insert Block Below |
| `⇧Space` | Insert Block Above |
| `⌘⇧⏎` | Open Insert Panel |

| `⌘⏎` | Assistant |
| `⌘⇧M` | Add or View Comments |
| `⌘Z` | Undo |
| `⌘⇧Z` | Redo |

## Window

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘⇧N` | New Window |
| `⌘W` | Close Tab or Window |
| `fnF` | Full Screen |
| `⌘T` | New Tab |
| `⌘1-9` | Switch to Tab 1-9 |

| `⌘⇧]` | Switch to Next Tab (alt) |
| `⌃⇧⇥` | Switch to Previous Tab |
| `⌘⇧[` | Switch to Previous Tab (alt) |
| `⌘⇧T` | Reopen Last Closed Tab |

## Template file

The full [`craft.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/craft.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
